name: Chiclana de la Frontera (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Chiclana de la Frontera (a castle between lions above waves on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Chiclana de la Frontera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Chiclana de la Frontera arms — castle between lions above waves
